_description: Bacterial Burden Quantification Pipeline - Configuration Template
_usage: Copy this file to config_bacterial.json and fill in your paths and plate layout
_batch_mode_note: Set true and add 'experiments' list for multi-experiment processing

plate_layout._note: Map well column numbers (as strings) to treatment names

group_colors._note: Colors for plots, keyed by treatment name

downsampling._num_positions_note: Number of field positions to randomly select per well

channels._note: Channel indices in the [Z, C, Y, X] image stack

z_projection._method_options: best_focus (Variance of Laplacian - recommended for adhered vs intracellular), mip (Maximum Intensity Projection), single_middle (middle Z slice)

qc._min_intensity_note: Channels with max intensity below this are flagged as empty/failed
qc._saturation_note: Fraction of pixels at max value; above this threshold = saturated

brightness_contrast._note: Per-channel brightness/contrast/gamma adjustment applied before segmentation

host_cell._model_note: Cellpose model for host cell cytoplasm segmentation
host_cell._diameter_note: 0 = auto-detect. Set manually if auto-detection fails
host_cell._use_nuclei_note: Feed nuclei channel as auxiliary input for better cell separation

filtering._clear_border_note: Remove host cells touching image edges
filtering._nucleus_note: Discard cells with 0 or >1 nuclei (dividing cells, syncytia, debris)

quantification._dilation_note: Ring width around cell boundary for detecting adhered bacteria
quantification._min_area_note: Minimum pixel area for a bacterial object to be counted

processing._save_masks_note: Save segmentation masks as TIFF for manual inspection
